# Kedro

> Kedro is an open-source Python framework for building reproducible, maintainable, and modular data engineering and data science pipelines.

A Kedro project is made of nodes (plain Python functions) connected into pipelines through named datasets. The Data Catalog, configured in `conf/base/catalog.yml`, maps those dataset names to storage. Parameters live in `conf/base/parameters.yml` and reach nodes as `params:<name>` inputs. The `kedro` CLI creates, runs, and packages projects.

Start with the [Kedro for LLMs cheatsheet](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/getting-started/kedro_for_llms/). To fetch any page below as Markdown, send `Accept: text/markdown, text/html;q=0.9`. Keep the HTML fallback: pages over 2 MB return HTTP 406 instead of Markdown when it is missing.

## Agent quick start

- [Kedro for LLMs](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/getting-started/kedro_for_llms/): Single-page cheatsheet with project layout, a minimal pipeline, core API and CLI indices, Data Catalog rules, and common errors with fixes

## Get started

- [Installation](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/getting-started/install/): Covers installation prerequisites, Python support policy, quickstart steps, verification methods and alternative setup options
- [Kedro concepts](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/getting-started/kedro_concepts/): Introduces basic Kedro elements including nodes, pipelines, the Data Catalog and project directory structure
- [FAQs](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/getting-started/faq/): Technical FAQs on installing Kedro, notebooks, project development, configuration, Data Catalog and pipelines
- [Video course](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/getting-started/course/): YouTube video course introducing Kedro pipeline building through the spaceflights tutorial
- [Build a pipeline visually](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/getting-started/pipeline_builder/): Browser-based drag-and-drop tool for designing Kedro pipelines without installation

## Tutorials

- [Spaceflight tutorial](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/tutorials/spaceflights_tutorial/): Overview and steps of the 30-minute spaceflights tutorial, which builds nodes and pipelines for a price-prediction model
- [Spaceflight tutorial template](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/tutorials/tutorial_template/): Creates the spaceflights project with kedro new and the spaceflights-pandas starter, then installs its dependencies
- [Set up data](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/tutorials/set_up_data/): Adds datasets to the data folder and registers them in Kedro's Data Catalog
- [Create a pipeline](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/tutorials/create_a_pipeline/): Builds a data processing pipeline that prepares data and creates a model input table
- [Add another pipeline](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/tutorials/add_another_pipeline/): Adds a data science pipeline using scikit-learn LinearRegression with parameters and model registration
- [Settings](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/tutorials/settings/): Explains settings.py application settings, such as Hooks registration and library components, and project metadata in pyproject.toml
- [Test a project](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/tutorials/test_a_project/): Covers unit testing for nodes, integration testing for pipelines and testing best practices
- [FAQs (Kedro Spaceflights tutorial)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/tutorials/spaceflights_tutorial_faqs/): Resolves common errors encountered during the Kedro spaceflights tutorial
- [Notebook tutorial](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/tutorials/notebooks_tutorial/): Explores Kedro projects in Jupyter notebooks using line magics and the ipython extension

## Create projects

- [Create a Kedro project](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/create/new_project/): Creates a basic Kedro project using kedro new and explains next steps
- [Create a minimal Kedro project](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/create/minimal_kedro_project/): Builds a minimal Kedro project from scratch explaining essential components step-by-step
- [Customise a new project](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/create/customise_project/): Customises a new Kedro project with tools and starters for specific requirements
- [Project tools](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/create/new_project_tools/): Customises new projects by specifying tools via CLI inputs or YAML configuration
- [Kedro starters](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/create/starters/): Explains how to use, version and create custom Kedro project starters

## Configuration

- [Configuration (Concepts)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/configure/configuration_basics/): Details Kedro project configuration using OmegaConfigLoader, sources, environments and loading
- [Parameters and credentials (Concepts)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/configure/parameters_and_credentials/): Explains how parameters and credentials work conceptually in Kedro projects
- [Templating (Concepts)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/configure/templating/): Covers variable interpolation, globals, runtime parameters and resolvers for Kedro configuration
- [Configuration (How-to Guides)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/configure/how_to_configure_project/): Configures projects for different scenarios including remote storage and runtime source changes
- [Parameters and credentials (How-to Guides)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/configure/how_to_use_parameters_and_credentials/): Shows how to use parameters in pipelines, validate them and load credentials via code or environment variables
- [Templating (How-to Guides)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/configure/how_to_use_templating/): Applies templating to parameters, catalog files and other configuration using OmegaConfigLoader
- [Config loader migration](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/configure/config_loader_migration/): Migrates deprecated ConfigLoader and TemplatedConfigLoader to the OmegaConfigLoader class

## Data Catalog

- [Introduction](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/introduction/): Introduces the Data Catalog as a registry of data sources with concepts and guides
- [Data Catalog (Concepts)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/data_catalog/): Explains catalog.yml basics, additional dataset settings such as load_args and credentials, and how the catalog maps dataset names to storage
- [Dataset factories (Concepts)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/kedro_dataset_factories/): Explains dataset factory patterns, resolution order and pipeline-aware catalog commands
- [Partitioned and incremental datasets](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/partitioned_and_incremental_datasets/): Explains PartitionedDataset and IncrementalDataset concepts including partition IDs and checkpoints
- [Lazy loading](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/lazy_loading/): Explains how the DataCatalog defers dataset instantiation until a dataset is first used
- [Configure the Data Catalog](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/how_to_configure_the_data_catalog/): Configures Data Catalog entries with load arguments, credentials, versioning and environment overrides
- [Use dataset factories](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/how_to_use_dataset_factories/): Applies dataset factory patterns for generalising datasets by type, namespace and layer
- [Use partitioned and incremental datasets](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/how_to_use_partitioned_and_incremental_datasets/): Configures and uses PartitionedDataset and IncrementalDataset with partitions, lazy saving and checkpoints
- [Access the Data Catalog in code](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/how_to_access_the_data_catalog_in_code/): Accesses, configures and manipulates the Data Catalog programmatically in Python code
- [Validate datasets](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/dataset_validation/): Validates catalog entries using Pandera, custom validators and on-demand checks
- [Data Catalog YAML examples](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/data_catalog_yaml_examples/): YAML examples for loading and saving text, CSV, pickle and Excel files locally and remotely

## Nodes and pipelines

- [Nodes](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/build/nodes/): Creates nodes with args, kwargs, tags, generators and preview functions
- [Pipeline object](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/build/pipeline_introduction/): Builds pipelines, merges multiple pipelines, tags them and inspects inputs and outputs
- [Run a pipeline](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/build/run_a_pipeline/): Executes pipelines using runners, custom runners, asynchronous IO and programmatic execution
- [Modular pipelines](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/build/modular_pipelines/): Creates pipelines with kedro pipeline create, structures pipeline code, uses custom pipeline templates and pipeline-specific dependencies
- [Namespaces](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/build/namespaces/): Groups and isolates nodes using namespaces to enable pipeline reuse with different inputs
- [Pipeline registry](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/build/pipeline_registry/): Defines pipeline registries with autodiscovery and selective loading in Kedro projects
- [Slice a pipeline](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/build/slice_a_pipeline/): Runs subsets of pipelines by inputs, nodes, tags or final nodes and recreates outputs
- [LLM context node](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/build/llm_context_node/): Constructs LLMContext datasets inside pipelines for downstream LLM execution and orchestration

## Development

- [Dependency management](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/develop/dependencies/): Declares and installs project-specific dependencies and sets up reproducible environments
- [Logging](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/develop/logging/): Configures default and advanced logging, custom filters and the rich handler in Kedro
- [Automated testing](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/develop/automated_testing/): Sets up automated testing with pytest and adds coverage reports using pytest-cov
- [Formatting and linting](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/develop/linting/): Sets up Python formatting tools and automated linting with pre-commit hooks
- [Inspect a project](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/inspect/inspect-project/): Reads project structure via the inspection API without running nodes or loading data
- [Vibe coding with MCP](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/develop/vibe_coding_with_mcp/): Installs and uses an MCP server for AI coding assistants in Kedro projects
- [Vibe coding with skills](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/develop/vibe_coding_with_skills/): Installs kedro-skills to provide AI assistants with Kedro conventions and contextual guidance

## Deployment

- [Overview](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/): Provides guides for different Kedro deployment methods and effective node grouping
- [How to package your project](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/package_a_project/): Builds project documentation and packages a Kedro project as a Python wheel with kedro package
- [How to group your nodes effectively](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/nodes_grouping/): Groups nodes by pipelines, tags and namespaces for deployment maintainability and control
- [Single-machine deployment](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/single_machine/): Deploys Kedro on a single production server using containers, packages or CLI
- [Distributed deployment](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/distributed/): Deploys Kedro in distributed systems by containerising pipelines and converting platform primitives
- [Apache Airflow](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/airflow/): Runs Kedro pipelines on Apache Airflow with Astronomer, MWAA or Kubernetes clusters
- [Amazon SageMaker](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/amazon_sagemaker/): Deploys Kedro pipelines on Amazon SageMaker using the kedro-sagemaker plugin
- [Amazon EMR Serverless](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/amazon_emr_serverless/): Deploys Kedro as Spark jobs on Amazon EMR Serverless with custom Docker images
- [AWS Step Functions](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/aws_step_functions/): Deploys Kedro pipelines on AWS Step Functions using Lambda and CDK scripts
- [Azure ML pipelines](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/azure/): Deploys Kedro pipelines to Azure ML using the kedro-azureml plugin
- [Dagster](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/dagster/): Orchestrates Kedro pipelines in Dagster using the kedro-dagster plugin
- [Dask](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/dask/): Distributes Kedro pipeline execution across Dask clusters for parallel computing
- [Databricks](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/databricks/): Runs Kedro on Databricks via Git folders, Databricks Connect or the kedro-databricks plugin
- [Kubeflow Pipelines](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/kubeflow/): Deploys Kedro pipelines on Kubeflow using the kedro-kubeflow plugin
- [Prefect](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/prefect/): Runs Kedro pipelines using Prefect 2.0 with a self-hosted Prefect Server
- [VertexAI](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/vertexai/): Runs Kedro pipelines on Vertex AI using the kedro-vertexai plugin
- [Argo Workflows](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/argo/): Runs Kedro pipelines on Argo Workflows with container-native orchestration on Kubernetes
- [AWS Batch](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/aws_batch/): Deploys Kedro namespaces as AWS Batch jobs with custom runners and container images

## Extend a project

- [Use cases](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/extend/common_use_cases/): Chooses the right extension mechanism: Hooks, custom datasets, CLI commands, or custom starters
- [Custom datasets](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/extend/how_to_create_a_custom_dataset/): Creates custom datasets by implementing load, save and describe methods using fsspec
- [Introduction (Hooks)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/extend/hooks/introduction/): Introduces Kedro Hooks covering specifications, implementations and execution order
- [Common use cases (Hooks)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/extend/hooks/common_use_cases/): Extends node behaviour, customises dataset IO, loads credentials and debugs pipelines using Hooks
- [Examples (Hooks)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/extend/hooks/examples/): Tracks memory, validates data, adds observability and changes node inputs using Hooks
- [Kedro sessions](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/extend/session/): Manages Kedro run lifecycles with KedroSession, KedroServiceSession and project bootstrapping
- [Serving over HTTP](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/extend/serving/): Starts an HTTP server to trigger pipeline runs and inspect metadata via REST endpoints
- [Custom plugins](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/extend/plugins/): Creates Kedro plugins with click commands, project context and lazy loading support
- [Custom starters](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/extend/create_a_starter/): Creates custom Kedro starters using cookiecutter with project variables and aliases

## Integrations and plugins

- [Introduction (IPython and Jupyter)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/notebooks_and_ipython/): Adds Kedro to existing notebook projects or notebooks to existing Kedro projects
- [Kedro and Jupyter notebooks](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/notebooks_and_ipython/kedro_and_notebooks/): Explores Kedro projects in Jupyter notebooks using line magics and the ipython extension
- [How to add Kedro to Jupyter Notebook](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/notebooks_and_ipython/notebook-example/add_kedro_to_a_notebook/): Incrementally adds Kedro features to a notebook using YAML configuration and refactoring
- [PySpark](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/pyspark_integration/): Best practices for PySpark pipelines using built-in datasets, Delta Lake and ThreadRunner
- [MLflow](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/mlflow/): Integrates MLflow for tracking experiments, packaging runs and deploying models in Kedro
- [DVC](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/dvc/): Versions datasets and pipelines using DVC with .dvc files and advanced workflows
- [Delta Lake](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/deltalake_versioning/): Uses Delta tables in Kedro catalogs with interactive inspection and Spark integration
- [Iceberg](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/iceberg_versioning/): Defines custom datasets for Apache Iceberg tables and inspects them interactively
- [Great Expectations](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/great_expectations/): Integrates Great Expectations for data quality validation and profiling in Kedro
- [Pandera](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/pandera/): Validates data schemas using Pandera with checks for pandas, PySpark and Polars

## IDE support

- [Visual Studio Code & Cursor](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/ide/set_up_vscode/): Sets up VS Code or Cursor with the Kedro extension, LSP validation and Kedro-Viz
- [PyCharm](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/ide/set_up_pycharm/): Configures PyCharm run configurations, remote interpreters and catalog validation schemas

## About

- [Kedro architecture](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/getting-started/architecture_overview/): Overview of Kedro architecture covering projects, framework, starters, library and extensions
- [Kedro security model](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/about/security_model/): Describes Kedro's security model, user responsibilities and vulnerability reporting procedures
- [Glossary](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/getting-started/glossary/): Defines key Kedro terms including Data Catalog, KedroContext, KedroSession and modular pipelines
- [Kedro's Technical Steering Committee](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/about/technical_steering_committee/): Outlines Kedro TSC roles, responsibilities and processes for maintainers, committers and advisors
- [Experimental APIs](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/about/experimental/): Explains the @experimental decorator for early-stage APIs and migration expectations
- [Migration guide](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/about/migration/): Migrates Kedro projects from 0.18.* to 0.19.* and from 0.19.* to 1.*
- [Kedro telemetry](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/about/telemetry/): Describes anonymised telemetry collection, data fields and consent withdrawal options

## Related projects

- [Kedro-Viz](https://docs.kedro.org/projects/kedro-viz/en/stable/): Interactive visualisation of Kedro pipelines, datasets, and run metadata
- [Kedro-Datasets](https://docs.kedro.org/projects/kedro-datasets/en/stable/): Dataset implementations for the Data Catalog, such as `pandas.CSVDataset` and `spark.SparkDataset`
- [Kedro-MCP](https://github.com/kedro-org/kedro-mcp): MCP server that gives coding assistants curated Kedro instructions
- [kedro-skills](https://github.com/kedro-org/kedro-skills): Context files for AI coding assistants working in Kedro projects
- [Kedro plugins](https://github.com/kedro-org/kedro-plugins): Official plugins, including kedro-airflow, kedro-docker, and kedro-telemetry
